name: dracor
description: Dracor: First Road — A browser-first social action RPG with high-end visual rendering

scripts.analyze:client: pnpm --filter @dracor/game-client build && echo 'Build complete — check dist/ size'
scripts.test:server: pnpm --filter @dracor/game-server typecheck && curl -s http://localhost:2567/health 2>/dev/null || echo 'Server not running — start with: pnpm --filter @dracor/game-server dev'
